trainer.config.countError: Enter 0 or a positive whole number within range.
trainer.config.name: Profile name
trainer.config.chooseSlot: Click a slot to choose its item.
trainer.config.saveLocked: Your edits are kept. Resolve the file conflict or error, then reload to try again. Reload replaces unsaved edits.
trainer.config.reloadConfirm: Replace your unsaved edits with the current saved file?
trainer.config.resetConfirm: Reset all changes to the last opened or saved layout?
trainer.config.discardConfirm: Discard unsaved layout changes and leave?
trainer.config.emptyConfirm: Require this slot to stay empty? This removes all its allowed items and custom settings.
trainer.config.ruleHelp: Required uses one allowed item. Optional is randomly filled or empty for each task. Empty must stay empty. Flexible accepts conserved leftover items; allowed items may supply fillers when generating a task, but do not create arbitrary items.
trainer.config.ruleConfirm: Change to “%s”? Allowed items and their edits will be kept.
trainer.config.removeConfirm: Remove this allowed item, including its quantity and custom settings?
trainer.config.nbtHelp: Use default leaves a field unspecified. Explicit {} is different. Unfinished text is kept until you correct or reset it.
trainer.config.matchingHelp: EXACT compares the complete compound. FIELDS matches a typed subset. With default match NBT, EXACT follows the normalized generation template; FIELDS follows raw generation NBT.
trainer.config.chooseProfileHelp: Click a layout name to use it for training, or Edit to change its items.
trainer.config.gate: Finish inventory restoration in local single-player and close LAN first.
trainer.config.quantityError: Check the quantity and stack limit.
trainer.config.saveFailed: Could not save. Your edits are kept: %s
trainer.config.reloadFailed: Could not reload. Your edits are kept: %s
trainer.config.reopenFailed: File saved, but reopening failed. Your edits are kept; reload after fixing the error: %s
trainer.config.deselectCustomConfirm: Deselect these items? Their custom NBT/matching settings will be removed. Removing the last item also makes this slot empty.
trainer.config.pbIncomplete: Some history could not be read. PBs use the available records.
trainer.config.layoutUnavailable: This layout is no longer available. Refresh and choose again.
trainer.config.duplicateLayout: Duplicate profile ID; this file cannot be selected for training.
trainer.arena.title: Practice arena
trainer.arena.resetConfirm: Restore the owned 64 × 64 arena to flat ground? Placed blocks and container contents within this area will be discarded. Your inventory is restored before resetting. The save and terrain outside this area are kept.
trainer.arena.error.ownership: The arena ownership or saved world cannot be verified. The operation stopped and existing data is kept. Check the log and restore a complete backup at its original path; then retry. An unknown folder must be backed up and moved aside before creating a new arena.
trainer.arena.error.recovery: Inventory recovery must finish first. Retry inventory recovery here or with P. If it remains locked, keep the original save and recovery data and check the log. Reset and exit cannot bypass recovery.
trainer.arena.error.save: The arena operation could not be confirmed as saved. It is not ready for training. Data is kept. Check free space and folder permissions, then retry; a pending operation resumes within the same area.
trainer.arena.error.reset_required: The arena no longer matches its flat-ground specification. Choose Reset arena to discard changes within the owned area, or return to the title without resetting.
trainer.arena.error.load: Minecraft could not load the practice arena. Saved data is kept. Check the log and folder access, then retry.
trainer.arena.error.local_only: Arena operations require a local single-player world with LAN closed. Close this world and reopen the arena from the title.
trainer.arena.error.none: The practice arena is unavailable. Check the log, then retry.
trainer.arena.progress.exit_restored: Inventory restored. Confirming save before leaving…
trainer.config.parkourOneTask: Parkour: one inventory task and one course. Finish both; no automatic repeat.
trainer.arena.convertConfirm: Switch the arena layout? This rebuilds the entire owned area (x/z -32..31, y 0..255), discarding blocks and container contents. Original inventory must be restored first. Ownership records are archived; the world and recovery binding stay at the same path.
trainer.parkour.returning: Returning to checkpoint — waiting for confirmed arrival
